mapper.select: SELECT b.id, t.user_id, t.user_name, t.avatar, b.update_time FROM user_visitor b LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON b.user_id = t.user_id WHERE b.by_user_id = #{userId} and t.user_id is not null order by b.update_time desc
